$schema_note: Single source of truth for design-tools. scripts/resolve.sh reads `roots` + `tools`; scripts/build.py regenerates commands/<tool>.md and wiki/ from `vendors` + `tools` + each installed SKILL.md. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/build.py`.

roots.name: design-studio
roots.note: The bake-off inventory. Canonical install of every vendor skill; `design-studio/scripts/install-all.sh` and `scripts/skillset.sh` maintain it.

ui-craft.name: ui-craft
ui-craft.author: educlopez
ui-craft.summary: The substrate. One base skill, three presets, eight phase commands, fifteen passes, three judges, two review agents. Owns the only durable project memory in the inventory (`.ui-craft/brief.md`, `.ui-craft/spec.md`).
ui-craft.contract: Every lens opens by asking to read `ui-craft/SKILL.md` first — let it. A lens without its base loses the anti-slop rules, the knobs, and the Craft Report format. The resolver prints the base path for you.

taste-skill.name: taste-skill
taste-skill.author: Leonxlnx
taste-skill.summary: Art-direction doctrine. The densest anti-slop text in the inventory (`design-taste-frontend`, 1206 lines), plus reference and image-generation skills, style presets, and the `full-output-enforcement` modifier.
taste-skill.contract: Orchestrator-class skills here want a context of their own. Image-generation skills need an image tool in the session.

impeccable.name: impeccable
impeccable.author: pbakaus
impeccable.summary: One skill with internal modes (`impeccable shape`, `impeccable audit`, `impeccable polish`, …), Apache 2.0, ships `scripts/` for image generation, live overlay and a CSP detector. The strongest authorial POV in the set and the most expensive: roughly 3× the tool calls of `design-taste-frontend`.
impeccable.contract: Orchestrator. Never in the same context as another orchestrator. Its `allowed-tools` assume `.claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/` relative to the project — when loaded from an external root, call the scripts by the absolute path the resolver prints.

emil.name: Emil Kowalski skills
emil.author: emilkowalski
emil.summary: The motion reference: component feel, springs, gestures, interruptibility, plus read-only planners and a reverse dictionary for naming effects.
emil.contract: Taste questions go here; performance questions go to ibelick. `prototype` and `review-animations` are `disable-model-invocation` — they only run when named.

ibelick.name: ui-skills
ibelick.author: ibelick
ibelick.summary: Three short, prescriptive checklists for the fast targeted fix when a 450-line doctrine is overkill.
ibelick.contract: Minutes, not hours. If the question is compliance or philosophy, go to osmani or emil instead.

osmani.name: web-quality-skills
osmani.author: addyosmani
osmani.summary: Performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), SEO, best practices, and an umbrella audit. MIT. The only vendor that covers SEO and CWV.
osmani.contract: Metrics and compliance. `web-quality-audit` first when the worst axis is unknown; the named skill when it is.

iart-ai.name: web-animation-skills
iart-ai.author: iart-ai
iart-ai.summary: Technique-level animation recipes: GSAP/ScrollTrigger, Lottie, SVG, page transitions, micro-interactions, glassmorphism, ASCII, 60fps and reduced-motion.
iart-ai.contract: How-to, not taste. Reach for these once the motion decision is made and a specific technique is named.

lottiefiles.name: motion-design-skill
lottiefiles.author: LottieFiles
lottiefiles.summary: Motion principles adapted for UI: timing, easing, choreography, the Disney twelve. MIT. Note: this is the `motion-design` skill installed in the inventory — not an Emil Kowalski skill, despite earlier notes.
lottiefiles.contract: System-agnostic (CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lottie, springs). Pair with `emil-design-eng` when one component needs feel rather than a plan.

kylezantos.name: design-motion-principles
kylezantos.author: kylezantos
kylezantos.install: git clone (nested repo; symlinked into the inventory 2026-08-20)
kylezantos.summary: Emil Kowalski / Jakub Krehel / Jhey Tompkins lenses in one skill; build mode and an audit mode that emits an HTML report with looping demos.
kylezantos.contract: Use the audit mode when the owner wants to *see* the motion review, not read it.

motion-dev.name: motion-dev-animations
motion-dev.author: 199-biotechnologies
motion-dev.summary: Motion.dev (Framer Motion successor) for React, Next.js, Svelte, Astro — 120fps GPU-accelerated patterns.
motion-dev.contract: Framework-specific. Only when the project is on Motion.dev / Framer Motion.

cloudai.name: threejs-skills
cloudai.author: cloudai-x
cloudai.install: git clone (nested repo; ten skills symlinked into the inventory 2026-08-20)
cloudai.summary: Ten vanilla Three.js technique references: fundamentals, loaders, materials, lighting, shaders, geometry, textures, animation, interaction, postprocessing.
cloudai.contract: Not a design vendor — it builds a competent scene inside whatever page it is given. React projects use the `core-3d-animation` plugin instead.

awwwards.name: claude-skill-awwwards
awwwards.author: tponscr-debug
awwwards.summary: Awwwards-winning design principles applied as a single orchestrator-style skill.

calm-design.name: calm-design
calm-design.author: calmtiger86
calm-design.summary: Full-stack 'calm premium' design agent that writes a DESIGN.md and runs visual self-critique and pre-flight checks. Korean-first prompts.
calm-design.contract: Orchestrator-class. Own context. Expect Korean in its own output unless told otherwise.

frontend-god-mode.name: frontend-god-mode
frontend-god-mode.author: Shawnchee
frontend-god-mode.summary: A consolidated 'do everything frontend' master skill — prior art for the orchestrators that followed.
frontend-god-mode.contract: Orchestrator-class. Own context. Broad trigger — it wants to fire on any UI request, which is exactly why the router exists.

design-skill-os.name: design-skill-os
design-skill-os.author: frhscopex
design-skill-os.summary: A design operating system synthesised from ten canonical design books: research, typography, colour theory, composition, branding, logo design, storytelling, process.
design-skill-os.contract: Reference reading, not a pass. Use when a decision needs a principle behind it.

groups.modifier: MODIFIER — on top of another tool
groups.phase: PHASE — ui-craft's conveyor steps (wrapped by design-pipeline)
groups.preset: PRESET — ui-craft base with a fixed aesthetic

ui-craft.for: the base: anti-slop rules, discovery, knobs, Craft Report; actions build|animate|review|polish|audit
ui-craft.not_for: a single aspect — use a lens

ui-craft-minimal.for: ui-craft with a minimal aesthetic fixed
ui-craft-minimal.not_for: surfaces with a brand contract — the contract owns the aesthetic

ui-craft-editorial.for: ui-craft with an editorial aesthetic fixed

ui-craft-dense-dashboard.for: ui-craft tuned for dense data dashboards

start.for: onboarding: explains the ladder and names the next rung

brief.for: writes `.ui-craft/brief.md` — purpose, user, principles, metric, out-of-scope
brief.not_for: a pass; it asks five questions and stops

tokens.for: establish or audit the three-layer token spine
tokens.not_for: inventing hues — the brand contract owns values

shape.for: wireframing one new section — writes `.ui-craft/spec.md`, not code
shape.not_for: a whole surface — that is the pipeline

craft.for: build a surface from the spec; recipes for dashboard, landing, auth
craft.not_for: e-commerce — no recipe, it falls back to standard build mode

sddesign.for: ui-craft's own six-gate express lane: brief → tokens → shape → craft → converge → ship
sddesign.not_for: anything design-pipeline already wraps — two conveyors fight

finalize.for: READY / NOT READY / BLOCKED before merge; findings only

polish.for: the final finish pass on a surface that is already right — reads `.ui-craft/brief.md` and project tokens
polish.not_for: a surface whose hierarchy is wrong; and not `impeccable polish` unless impeccable is named

typeset.for: type scale, tracking, optical size, hierarchy
typeset.not_for: choosing a typeface for a new brand

colorize.not_for: inventing a palette — the contract owns that

adapt.for: breakpoints, mobile layout, container queries, touch targets, safe areas
adapt.not_for: a layout that is wrong at every width

distill.for: cutting noise from an over-built surface

quieter.for: restraint, toning down, reducing accent load

extract.for: pulling repeated markup into components and tokens

redesign.for: ui-craft's redesign lens for an existing surface
redesign.not_for: the router — a redesign is pipeline work

animate.for: animation inside the project's motion tokens

unhappy.for: states before the happy path; impossible booleans into a state machine

harden.for: skeletons, empty, error, partial, i18n, offline, permissions, first-run

clarify.for: UX copy: errors, empty states, CTAs, voice matrix, reading level

audit.for: technical a11y audit inside a build session
audit.not_for: a compliance report — that is osmani `accessibility`

design-taste-frontend.for: art direction at DESIGN_VARIANCE ≤ 6: brief inference, three dials, AI-tells list, block library
design-taste-frontend.not_for: a pass; and never beside another orchestrator

design-taste-frontend-v1.for: the previous, shorter version of `design-taste-frontend` (226 lines)
design-taste-frontend-v1.not_for: new work — kept for comparison only

gpt-taste.for: taste-skill's variant tuned for GPT-style output

high-end-visual-design.for: making an existing surface read as expensive: shadows, cards, spacing; 'absolute zero' anti-patterns

brandkit.for: identity boards, logo systems, brand guideline boards — needs image generation
brandkit.not_for: surfaces; and not for YOURSAUNAS, whose identity is in the brand contract

imagegen-frontend-web.for: one horizontal reference image per section of a web surface

imagegen-frontend-mobile.not_for: web surfaces — use the web variant

image-to-code.for: generate a reference → analyse → code it; tuned for Codex

full-output-enforcement.for: bans placeholders and truncated output — switch on whenever the chosen tool will write a long file
full-output-enforcement.not_for: use on its own; it modifies another tool

redesign-existing-projects.for: taste-skill's redesign protocol for an existing project
redesign-existing-projects.not_for: the router — a redesign is pipeline work

stitch-design-taste.for: taste-skill tuned for Google Stitch handoff

impeccable.for: high-variance art direction (DESIGN_VARIANCE ≥ 7) with internal modes: shape · audit|critique · animate|bolder|colorize|delight|layout|overdrive|quieter|typeset · adapt|clarify|distill · harden|onboard|optimize|polish · init|document|extract|live
impeccable.not_for: a cheap pass; ~3× the cost of `design-taste-frontend`; never beside another orchestrator

motion-design.for: timing, easing, choreography from scratch; Disney principles adapted for UI

emil-design-eng.for: component feel, springs, the invisible details; component contracts; review format

apple-design.for: gestures, drag, sheets, interruptibility, velocity handoff, momentum

find-animation-opportunities.for: where motion is missing but earned

improve-animations.for: audit all motion and produce a plan for other agents

review-animations.for: review animation code against Emil's craft bar — default to flagging, approval is earned

animation-vocabulary.for: naming an effect you can only describe

pick-ui-library.for: choosing a UI component library for a stack

ask-sonner.for: questions about the Sonner toast library

prototype.for: build several genuinely different versions of one UI piece behind a visual picker
prototype.not_for: the router — it only runs when named (`disable-model-invocation`)

baseline-ui.for: the base tidiness checklist — spacing, alignment, contrast, consistency

fixing-accessibility.for: fast keyboard / focus / ARIA fixes — a named defect

fixing-motion-performance.for: jank, layout thrashing, compositor-only properties, reduced-motion, perf budget

accessibility.for: full WCAG 2.2, POUR, conformance level, pre-launch

performance.for: payload, critical path, fonts, images, caching

seo.for: meta, structured data, sitemap, robots, on-page

web-quality-audit.for: umbrella: performance + a11y + SEO + best practices at once
web-quality-audit.not_for: fixing — it names the worst axis, then you work that axis

design-motion-principles.for: build or audit motion; audit emits an HTML report with looping demos
design-motion-principles.not_for: when a plain text answer is wanted

motion-dev-animations.for: Motion.dev / Framer Motion patterns for React, Next.js, Svelte, Astro

60fps-animation.for: make a janky CSS animation hit 60fps

glassmorphism.not_for: YOURSAUNAS surfaces unless the brand contract allows it

gsap-web.for: GSAP: ScrollTrigger, pinning, scrub, SplitText, Flip, Lenis

svg-animation.for: SVG path, morph, and line-drawing animation

threejs-fundamentals.for: scene setup, cameras, renderer, Object3D hierarchy, coordinates

awwwards.for: Awwwards-style visual ambition on a surface

calm-design.for: calm premium direction with a DESIGN.md output and self-critique

frontend-god-mode.for: the consolidated master skill — any frontend request

design.for: design principles from ten canonical books, when a decision needs a reason behind it
